services.summary: Fire suppression, emergency medical response, and rescue, staffed 24 hours. All personnel are certified EMTs and both front-line engines double as ambulances (defibrillators, Narcan, EpiPens). The department runs vehicle extrication and water rescue with a public safety boat, fire-prevention inspections, and public education. Its "First Night is On Us" program gives any resident whose home is temporarily uninhabitable from fire or flood complimentary first-night lodging.
